queries.nodes: MATCH (n) RETURN label(n) AS label, count(n) AS total ORDER BY label
queries.relationships: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN label(r) AS label, count(r) AS total ORDER BY label
queries.aggregate: MATCH (d:Disease)-[:HAS_SYMPTOM]->(s:Symptom) RETURN d.name AS disease, count(DISTINCT s) AS symptom_count ORDER BY symptom_count DESC, disease
queries.deleted_demo_count: MATCH (x:Symptom {name:'临时症状-CRUD'}) RETURN count(x) AS remaining
queries.symptoms_query: MATCH (d:Disease)-[:HAS_SYMPTOM]->(s:Symptom) WHERE d.name = $disease RETURN d.name AS disease, collect(s.name) AS symptoms
